name: Klumgongyn
dialogue: Ah, Agent K. Have you filed your xenodiplomatic paperwork yet? No? Fascinating species.
Varnyr has three moons, Agent. Your coffee has zero. I rest my case.
Tiberian Dynamics Worldwide is a perfectly normal software company. Say it with me.
I have reviewed your planet's reports on the Order of Hades. Deeply rude organization.

name: The Overseer
dialogue: Contracts do not solve themselves, Agent K. Walk away from my corner and go solve one.
SERPENT has operated since 1968. Do not be the reason it stops.
The Order of Hades predates us all. Respect the threat. Then beat it.

name: Agent Reyes
dialogue: If the coffee machine is empty again, I am blaming you specifically, K.
I heard someone typed SNAKE into the BIOS last week. No idea who. Legend.
Field Ops sweep went clean. Boring is good. Boring keeps us alive.
The whiteboard in the breakroom is mandatory reading. GARY added a note.
